messages:
mari: hey all, mari here — hello from infra onboarding. running into a permissions wall while trying to spin up a small GKE cluster in project redwood-dev-apac. I get a 403 when trying to enable the Compute API and when I run `gcloud beta billing projects link`. error: "Permission 'resourcemanager.projects.setBillingInfo' denied." anyone able to point me to the right process or person to get the billing link added? also need to get cross-account AWS assume role access for staging.

evant: welcome mari! :wave: for billing links we funnel through infra-requests. put the project id + target billing account in the form and pick "billing link". paste the request id here and i'll escalate.

mari: thanks evan. project id: redwood-dev-apac. billing acct: 0123-4567-8901. I tried cli and got same permission error.

lucy: tagging @cloud-onboarding — org policy typically restricts who can attach billing. infra can do the link after a request, or we can create a short-lived SA with billing.user on the project but finance prefers infra-led linking for audit reasons.

platform-oncall-bot: FYI: Org constraint constraints/compute.disableSerialPortAccess active. Run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-dev-apac` to confirm current bindings.

mari: pasted the get-iam-policy output below:
```
bindings:
- members:
  - serviceAccount:project-org-admins@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  role: roles/billing.user
```

evant: yep that shows only the org admin SA has billing.user. sounds like infra needs to attach it. open infra-requests and set urgency to high if you need the cluster today. include nodes/machine-type and region so finance can estimate cost.

tom: for the AWS side, what do you need exactly? if it's assume-role across accounts we have a template role arn: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/Redwood-Staging-Developer. give me your user ARN and I'll add a trust entry. we try to gate new hires to 90-day role duration.

mari: i need sts:AssumeRole and s3:GetObject on redwood-staging-artifacts. my user: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/mari

lucy: tom please create role and set max session duration 1 hour for initial onboarding, add mari as trusted principal. also note in the ticket that this is for canary testing in asia-southeast1.

platform-oncall-bot: Infra request created: IR-9876. Assigned to infra-ops. ETA ~4 business hours.

tom: role created. run:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/Redwood-Staging-Developer --role-session-name mari-onboard
```
session token valid for 1h. I added an inline policy for s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging-artifacts/* and a trust policy allowing arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/mari.

mari: tried it, assume worked and i can access the bucket. also filed infra request (IR-9876) with notes: 3x n1-standard-8 nodes, region asia-southeast1, will run canary traffic.

evant: good — i pinged finance and infra-ops. if they can attach billing we can proceed; otherwise infra can temporarily create SA to do the link but that'll need an audit entry.

platform-oncall-bot: Billing attachment completed by infra-ops. Project redwood-dev-apac now linked to billing account 0123-4567-8901.

mari: cluster creation succeeded after billing link. thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick help. marking resolved. :tada:
